title: FPGA Research Engineer
summary: Technically relevant FPGA research role with limited employment and work-model evidence.
source_text: SignalFoundry is looking for an FPGA Research Engineer in Germany. You will prototype real-time signal-processing systems and integrate FPGA hardware with embedded software. Hands-on FPGA experience is required; C++ is advantageous. Details about remote work, weekly hours, salary, and the employment contract are available during the interview process.

facts.evidence_quote: integrate FPGA hardware with embedded software
